_comment: Which bible each campaign under books/parts/ was lifted from. The fragments used to carry the path in their own header comment, and that broke the first time a bible was re-uploaded under a new name — six of the eight arrived as `…(1)(1).md` and every header pointed at a file that no longer existed. One map, one place to correct. Round 13 arrived under clean short names (CARRYING_Round13.md and so on), which is the first set that needed no repointing guesswork. Paths are relative to gamekit/.
